# Total reusable noncommuting receiver on one closed code wire

16 October 2026. Modified generator. This is a **fixed five-site base operation**, with an actual reusable two-bank contract. It is not a recursive compiler, universal computation construction, general interacting-lattice eroder, or threshold theorem. The terminal map is fully specified below, but is one atomic five-site engineered CPTP jump. Enlarging its support with encoding level is not permitted by this result.

The construction retains actual noncommuting logical operations. At terminal number n its quantum output is the alternating word `X_L, C_L, X_L, C_L, ...` through n, not an identity obtained by undoing every gate. Independent onsite fast-path proposals may apply portions of the next transversal operation. A total terminal receiver finishes the missing suffix, recovers the code, transfers ownership and resets all control copies. It can accept from every physical state. This removes one-use authorization and raw occupancy guards in this finite closed receiver.

## Hardware and code

Five distinct noisy physical sites lie in one fixed bounded-diameter motif, e.g. five cells of a 2 by 3 rectangle. Each carries two qutrit data banks `A_i,B_i` with levels `0,1,perp`, one phase copy `r_i in Z_4`, and one progress bit `l_i in {0,1}`. The local Hilbert dimension is `3*3*4*2=72`. No program word, coordinate color, input token or occupancy flag is stored. The motif and the two gate matrices are hardwired couplings. Identically translated motifs can be independent cells; this does not establish a one-site translation-invariant interacting hierarchy.

`V:C^2 -> (C^2)^5 subset (C^3)^5` is the standard five-qubit perfect code with stabilizers `XZZXI, IXZZX, XIXZZ, ZXIXZ`; `X_L=XXXXX`, `Z_L=ZZZZZ`. Define

```
X = [[0,1],[1,0]],
C = (I - i(X+Y+Z))/2.
U_r = X if r is even, C if r is odd.
```

Both transversal `U_r` preserve this code. Their induced logical channels are `Ad_X` and `Ad_C`, which do not commute. Every physical gate uses the qutrit extension `U_r tilde = U_r direct-sum 1_perp`. The exact code/isometry check is in `check_receiver.py`; the proof uses the stabilizer action, not floating-point tolerance.

# Receiver proof, stopped exposure and exact boundary

## 1. Totality and canonical retirement

The control sector projectors indexed by all `(r_i,l_i)` are orthogonal and sum to identity. On each sector, d selects one residue. The suffix is a product of qutrit unitaries; tracing/preparing the unowned bank is CPTP; R is CPTP; moving a code from one bank to a vacated bank and preparing the old source is CPTP; the final control reset is CPTP. Summing sector channels proves T is CPTP, including on coherent control inputs and arbitrary references.

The range of R is the five-qubit code for every input. Therefore T always produces exactly one code-bank owner, vacuum in the other bank, and uniform `(r+1,0)` controls. This property is unconditional. It gives a real reusable reset channel rather than a promise that an invalid local counter star eventually becomes valid. The terminal clock never inspects an exterior. From any physical state, the time to the next ideal T is Exp(lambda); noisy microsteps or onsite faults do not disable it. Every old progress marker, phase copy and unused-bank phantom is consumed in that event. There is no acknowledgment/message object which can survive a wrap.

## 2. Qutrit correctability

The five-qubit code has distance three. Its 16 Pauli syndromes for `I,X_i,Y_i,Z_i` are distinct. Hence their code images are orthogonal with scalar Gram identity. A leakage map `L_(i,b)=|perp><b|_i` has

```
V^dagger L_(i,b)^dagger L_(i,c) V
 = V^dagger |b><c|_i V = delta_bc I/2.
```

This uses that every nonidentity one-site Pauli has zero code expectation. Leakage at different sites has orthogonal vacancy patterns, and leakage images are orthogonal to the no-vacancy Pauli images. Thus the 26-map diagonal Gram identity in the specification is exact. An arbitrary map from a qubit input to a qutrit at one site is a linear combination of its qubit Pauli block and its two leakage matrix units. R consequently corrects its entire span. Orthogonal syndrome isometries plus an explicitly assigned complement establish trace preservation and a fixed decoder, rather than KL existence alone.

# Repeated encoded transactions with local bank movement

16 October 2026. Independent construction. Internal mathematical status only.

This is a **fixed-size, periodic, noninteracting-cell theorem** in an ideal engineered-jump plus onsite-Poisson-noise model. It supplies finite A/B reuse, total damaged-control retirement, a reference-uniform quantum contract, and an elementary all-set bad-epoch estimate at that scale. It does not supply a noisy circuit implementation of recovery, interactions between cells, an arbitrary program stream, a recursive controller, or a threshold. In particular, the fixed-support recovery jump below is an explicit remaining physical interface.

## 1. Alphabet and geometry

A cell has five physical sites, indexed i=1,...,5. Each site contains two qutrit banks A_i,B_i and a three-valued classical phase r_i in {0,1,2}. A qutrit is span{|0>,|1>,|v>}, with |v> vacancy. Thus the local Hilbert-space dimension is 27 if the classical phase is represented by dephased quantum sectors. Arrange the five sites in any fixed bounded region of a two-dimensional lattice; all maps below then have a fixed finite range. There are no dynamically stored program symbols. The repeated word is hardwired into the local jump types.

Use the [[5,1,3]] code C in the qubit subspace of A_1...A_5, with stabilizers

    XZZXI, IXZZX, XIXZZ, ZXIXZ.

Let P be its rank-two projector, and take X_L=X^tensor5, Z_L=Z^tensor5. Put

    C = (I - i(X+Y+Z))/2,
    W_0=I, W_1=X, W_2=CX,
    U = C^tensor5 X^tensor5 restricted to C.

The logical channels of C^tensor5 and X^tensor5 do not commute: C_L sends logical X to logical Y. This is not only a commuting correction cycle.
